title: HONOR THE LORD
WITH THY SUBSTANCE
end: The Provision Table — walk in God's daily provision

scenes.a: If you are holding back your last resources with a fearful heart, listen closely.
Lord, help us to remember that everything we possess comes from Your open hand.
Teach us to place our trust in Your provision rather than our own calculations.
As Your word commands, we hear this truth today:
scenes.sub: HEAR THE WORD OF THE LORD

scenes.a: Honor the LORD with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thine increase:
scenes.sub: HONOR THE LORD WITH THY SUBSTANCE

scenes.a: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, and thy presses shall burst out with new wine.
Father, grant us faithful obedience in our finances this day.
